page = 0

    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    notes.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Notes:", notes)

        break
    projects.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Projects:", projects)

# Convert durations to minutes for easier calculation
def to_minutes(duration, unit):
    if unit == 'minutes':
        return duration
    elif unit == 'hours':
        return duration * 60
    elif unit == 'days':
        return duration * 1440
    else:
        return duration

today_durations = [to_minutes(t['duration'], t['duration_unit']) for t in today_incomplete]
